lessons.title: supabase port-bind on docs-only PR
lessons.body: When a docs-only PR triggers the supabase CI image, it can race the port bind and time out. Use gh run rerun --failed once; do NOT heal with a code fix.

lessons.title: em-dash sign-extension under LC_ALL=C
lessons.body: An em-dash byte run in JSON output trips bash 3.2 string-length under LC_ALL=C. Always preflight via preflight_json_escape, never roll your own.

lessons.title: node:sqlite types narrow only after .all()
lessons.body: Calling node:sqlite prepared.run() returns unknown columns; .all() returns the typed shape. Adopt .all() in adapters.

lessons.title: forward-reference helpers in bin/fleet
lessons.body: A new helper defined BELOW the dispatcher block dies at runtime with command not found because the if-check runs at execution time. Always define helpers ABOVE.

lessons.title: gh pr create needs --head user:branch from agent runs
lessons.body: Agent checkouts run inside cache dirs; the local branch is not a tracking branch for the operator. Pass --head user:branch explicitly.
